prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right ran its red and struck the passenger side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and pushed it toward the curb. I stayed in the driver's seat until the police arrived, and I gave the officer the same description of what happened that I have given to the adjuster and to everyone else I have spoken with since. I am the named driver on this policy and I was the person operating the vehicle at the time. Shortly after the collision I noticed stiffness and pain in my neck, which a doctor later diagnosed as a neck strain. I have been following the treatment plan, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be processed.
